WHAT I SAW: Today the funnel logged 1,284 ticks, 41 signals, 27 ENTER attempts; 13 were rule‑blocked (4 bold, 9 safe) leaving 14 attempts, 14 accepts, 12 fills and 12 exits.  
WHAT I DID: I executed the 12 fills, which yielded 17 round‑trips (risky‑1:3, risky‑3:5, safe‑1:6, safe‑3:3). I also merged 12 commits today, including vision‑layer upgrades (V4 kill, V3 live trendline reads) and the LOUD‑ping on first engine fill (commit 49144ae).  
WHAT I LEARNED: The risk gate is working as intended—PDT rules blocked entries because equity stayed below $25 k, confirming the gate’s enforcement.  
WHAT I'M CHANGING: I shipped the Gamma_TradeToday LOUD‑ping that alerts J on the first engine fill (commit 49144ae).  
One lever I want to test: overnight hold: RTH‑only everywhere — futures overnight session levels untested; today’s PDT block makes holding overnight attractive to preserve day‑trade capacity.  
One question for J: Would you be open to trying overnight SPY‑future holds to sidestep the PDT limit while keeping the same setups?
